_sheet: Hooks into PEAK. One row = one place the mod attaches to the game. Harmony rows generate a patch class in Generated/HarmonyHooks.cs whose Prefix/Postfix forward to CampfireCards.Hooks.<handler>Prefix / CampfireCards.Hooks.<handler>; event and unity rows are subscribed by hand in Hooks.Subscribe() (preflight checks the member name appears there).

_columns.signature: comma-separated parameter types of the target for overload resolution; empty = unique
_columns.prefixArgs: verbatim C# parameter list of the generated Prefix (empty = no prefix)
_columns.prefixBool: true = the Prefix returns bool (false skips the original)
_columns.postfixArgs: verbatim C# parameter list of the generated Postfix (empty = no postfix); '-' = none
_columns.handler: base name of the static methods in CampfireCards.Hooks
_columns.verified: how it was confirmed against the decompiled game

rows.purpose: a climb started on this client: reset per-run card state, schedule the opening pick once the beach wake-up ends

rows.postfixArgs: Campfire __instance, bool updateSegment, float burningFor, Campfire.FireState __state
rows.purpose: fire goes Off -> Lit with updateSegment: start a pick session (host decides order) and grant bonusStamina
rows.verified: Campfire.cs Light_Rpc(bool updateSegment, float burningFor), PEAK_API_NOTES 1 and 8.1

rows.signature: CharacterAfflictions.STATUSTYPE, float, bool, bool, bool, bool, bool
rows.prefixArgs: CharacterAfflictions __instance, CharacterAfflictions.STATUSTYPE statusType, ref float amount
rows.purpose: toughness, coldResist, poisonResist, heatResist and fallDamage scale the status before it lands
rows.verified: CharacterAfflictions.cs AddStatus(STATUSTYPE statusType, float amount, bool fromRPC, bool playEffects, bool notify, bool ignoreInvincibility, bool ignoreSkeleton)

rows.purpose: mark that the next AddStatus is fall damage; bounceOnLand skips the injury and bounces the climber
staminaRegen: add 0.2 * t * fixedDeltaTime when the game itself would regenerate
rows.verified: Character.cs private void UpdateVariablesFixed() + private bool CanRegenStamina(), PEAK_API_NOTES 8.4

rows.purpose: extraJumps: add the card total to totalExtraJumps every time the game recomputes it
the game clears afflictions on revive: re-apply this character's card effects
write 'Hosting at <steam lobby id>' to the mod's net.log so a launcher that lists open games can show joiners the address
rows.verified: SteamLobbyHandler.cs:396 private void OnLobbyCreated(LobbyCreated_t), LobbySteamId property line 44

rows.purpose: close any open card picker when the run ends
a Character appeared (local or remote, incl. reconnect): apply the effects we know for its owner; the host also resends full state to a late joiner
lifesteal: eating heals injury; re-subscribed after every scene load because the game nulls GlobalEvents
leaving the island (Airport/Title): clear run state, close UI, re-subscribe GlobalEvents
receive the mod's RaiseEvent codes (see net.json)
